That sufficiently establishes conventional functionality, so the final negative is supported despite the blind proposal's weaker route.

records.rationale: The description meaningfully states SaaS performance monitoring and automated remediation: it assesses availability, health, and end-user experience and generates automations to remediate issues. These are conventional functions, with no affirmative AI/ML signal.
